freshResearch.officialViewerInspection: The official Enping government host was attempted directly over HTTPS, but this environment received an OpenSSL TLS internal-error alert before an HTTP response. The official search-indexed pages were inspected through first-party result content; no current JavaScript viewer, map configuration, public cadastral API, schema, CRS, or bounded anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was exposed. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, credential, private token, or unsafe owner/address/titleholder field was used.

registryBasis: First-party Enping government material documents the citywide rural real-estate registration program and cadastral survey/registration outputs; official Enping/Jiangmen government material names the Enping Real Estate Transaction Registration Center and the Enping Natural Resources Bureau as the local registration/natural-resources custodians. This establishes a local registry/procedure custodian, not open parcel-vector access.

geometryDecision.reason: No bounded anonymous request returned a safe native parcel identity and full polygon geometry. The exact WUP point was not shifted, and the direct-host TLS failure plus lack of a published vector endpoint is not treated as citywide absence.

technicalBlocker: A current public Enping cadastral viewer/API, safe native parcel ID, schema, CRS, and bounded geometry response remain unverified. Direct HTTPS requests to the official Enping host failed during TLS negotiation in this environment.
remainingUncertainty: The local registration center may operate an authenticated or non-indexed cadastral service, and official map services may be reachable from a different network path. Exact-point parcel coverage, CRS/schema, public accessibility, and citywide completeness remain unknown.
nextStep: A serial reviewer may independently qualify a first-party Enping parcel adapter only after confirming a current public route, CRS/schema, safe native ID fields, and bounded anonymous geometry response.
